fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Front Entry Area; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the front entry without obstruction.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway so responders can move along it without restricted visibility or physical obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation that is growing close to the detached structure to allow responders to move around all sides of it.
• Mark or unlock any gate or passage connecting the front of the property to the rear so responders are not delayed searching for rear access.
• Keep a clear path around the main residence so responders are not forced to push through dense vegetation when working around the structure.
• If a second access point to the property can be created, work with local fire or emergency services to evaluate its placement.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Brush Area; Open Terrain; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Vegetation Separation; Vegetation Along Driveway; Scattered Shrubs; Large Trees; Mixed Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim all shrubs and low branches that are directly touching or within a few feet of the house walls.
• Remove shrubs and brush growing directly against the foundation on all sides of the house.
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest the house to create open space between their canopies and the structure.
• Raise the lower branches of large trees near the house so no branches hang close to the roofline or walls.
• Clear brush and shrubs from the area immediately surrounding any detached structures on the property.
• Thin the mixed vegetation between the scattered trees and the house to break up the continuous plant cover leading to the structure.
• Cut back shrubs and overhanging branches along both sides of the driveway to keep the full width passable.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from within shrub groupings near the house.
• Thin shrubs scattered across the property where they connect open terrain vegetation directly to the house.
• Keep the area under large trees near the house clear of shrubs and ground-level brush that could carry fire up into the tree canopy.
• Maintain a mowed or cleared strip along the driveway edges so vegetation does not reclaim the travel surface or shoulders.
• Separate shrub groupings near the house so there are visible gaps of bare ground or short grass between them.
